scope: DEV only (no VAL needed for the panel; no CONF); calendar-corrected generator (generate2 with drop)
draws: Md in {8, 16, 32}, nested (first Md of the 32 draws of a repetition), 2 independent repetitions (rep 0, rep 1)
evaluation: all 10 actions on two DISJOINT sets of true futures: A = r 1..8 (protocol), B = r 9..16

criteria.relative_regret_between_reps: |L_A(choice_rep0) - L_A(choice_rep1)| / L_A(none) <= 0.005 (same tolerance as decision n.7)
criteria.evaluation_stability: per decision: |gain_A - gain_B| for (F choice vs R1 choice) and for (best-by-A vs none); Spearman of the 10 action losses A vs B; argmin agreement A vs B

rule_for_pilot: keep Md = 32 for F and R1 in the pilot if the regret tolerance holds for both at Md = 32; otherwise report the instability, keep Md = 32 (no larger Md affordable) and treat F and R1 as non-exact decision references. No AUC verdict is sought.
recorded_parameters_check: list Mr / Md / E recorded in every B-FRAG 2 run file (DEV, TRAIN, VAL, CONF tags)
